# AP News

> > AP News delivers breaking news, live updates, and comprehensive coverage of global events, US politics, and regional conflicts with multimedia reporting.

AP News is the digital news platform of the Associated Press, providing real-time coverage of international affairs, geopolitical conflicts, US national news, and regional developments. The site offers content in multiple languages and features specialized news hubs for major ongoing stories, weather alerts, and policy coverage.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Iran Conflict
- Russia-Ukraine War
- Trump Administration
- Middle East Geopolitics
- International Relations
- Energy Crisis
- Military Conflict
- Sanctions
- US Politics
- China-US Relations
- NATO
- Regional Conflicts
- Live Coverage
- Immigration Policy

## Global News Hubs

- [Associated Press News: Breaking News, Latest Headlines and Videos](https://apnews.com): AP News homepage with breaking news, latest headlines and videos globally
- [World News: Top & Breaking World News Today](https://apnews.com/world-news): World news hub covering breaking stories from across the globe
- [Europe News | Breaking European News Today](https://apnews.com/hub/europe): Europe news hub with EU politics, Ukraine war and sanctions coverage
- [Asia Pacific | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/asia-pacific): Asia-Pacific regional news hub with geopolitics and latest updates
- [Latin American News | Latest Latin American News](https://apnews.com/hub/latin-america): Latin America news hub covering regional politics and sports
- [Africa News Reports | Latest News in Africa](https://apnews.com/hub/africa): Africa news hub covering regional conflicts and humanitarian issues

## Major Conflict Coverage

- [Russia-Ukraine | Breaking News & Live Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/russia-ukraine): Russia-Ukraine war coverage with live updates and breaking news
- [Iran war | AP News](https://apnews.com/hub/iran): Iran war news hub with coverage of Iran-Israel-US conflicts
- [Global fuel prices soar as Iran hits Gulf energy sites](https://apnews.com/article/iran-iraq-us-israel-trump-march-19-2026-52e94398f2432b3aba9b02b51fbe5000): Iran attacks Gulf energy sites, causing global fuel price surge
- [Trump's failed strong-arming of allies on Iran shows that pressure is losing its effect](https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-war-trump-starmer-macron-germany-caff1073f932ddb88c3d75c7c356ebc7): Trump's diplomatic pressure on NATO allies regarding Iran conflict

## Regional & Country Coverage

- [China | Latest News from China Today](https://apnews.com/hub/china): China news hub covering US-China relations and trade policy
- [Últimas Noticias del Mundo | AP News](https://apnews.com/hub/noticias): Spanish-language international news hub from AP News

## US National News

- [U.S. News: Top U.S. News Today](https://apnews.com/us-news): US national news hub covering politics, health policy and labor
- [Immigration | AP News](https://apnews.com/hub/immigration): Immigration policy news hub covering border enforcement and deportations
- [Abortion | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/abortion): Abortion policy news hub covering reproductive rights legislation
- [Education | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/education): Education news hub covering school policy and student safety
- [Transportation | AP News](https://apnews.com/us-news/transportation): Transportation news hub covering transit, aviation and rail systems

## Weather & Natural Disasters

- [Weather, Hurricanes and Storms | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/weather): Weather news hub with hurricane, storm and severe weather alerts

## Newsletters & Subscriptions

- [Newsletters | AP News](https://apnews.com/newsletters): Free email newsletter signup with Morning Wire, Afternoon Wire and alerts
